backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing the game backend with player profiles, friends, settings, job management, and authorization/blob-storage mixins for the Maplewood Canada game.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report mapping feature IDs to their implementing source files, components, and test IDs for the Maplewood Canada game project.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON object containing one-line summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a quick reference for the project's frontend architecture.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining light and dark theme CSS custom properties (colors, borders, chart colors, sidebar) for the app.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that mounts the React app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing home/game view switching, profile setup modal display, authentication state, and wrapping the app in ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/ChatUI.tsx: In-game chat overlay component with a scrollable message list, text input, mic toggle, and support for global, proximity, and system message types.
frontend/src/components/FriendsList.tsx: Friends list modal with tabs for viewing current friends and searching for new players, supporting add/remove friend actions via React Query mutations.
frontend/src/components/GameCard.tsx: Renders a game card UI with thumbnail, genre badge, rating, play count, and a play button. Supports a featured variant with larger image and description display.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Top navigation header with logo, nav links, search input, and user actions including Internet Identity login/logout, friends list, notifications, and settings panel.
frontend/src/components/HUD.tsx: Displays the in-game heads-up display with stat bars (health, armor, hunger, thirst), wanted level indicator, mini-map, equipped item, and current job label.
frontend/src/components/InteractionPromp: Shows a contextual 'Press E to interact' prompt overlay at the bottom-center of the screen when visible is true.
frontend/src/components/InventoryUI.tsx: Tabbed inventory panel displaying weapons, accessories, consumables, and abilities with equip/unequip functionality and special handling for the flight ability toggle.
frontend/src/components/JobBoard.tsx: Modal UI listing available in-game jobs (police, SWAT, paramedic, dealership, unemployed) with apply buttons that call the updateJob mutation and show the player's current job.
frontend/src/components/MiniMap.tsx: Renders a small 144×144 map overlay with a background image, landmark icons positioned by fixed coordinates, and an animated dot tracking the player's world position.
frontend/src/components/PauseMenu.tsx: Renders a pause menu overlay with buttons for resuming, settings, map, profile, and exiting; opens a SettingsPanel modal when settings is clicked.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog for new users to enter a player name and create their character profile, calling the saveCallerUserProfile mutation on submit.
frontend/src/components/SettingsPanel.ts: A tabbed settings panel (Gameplay, Graphics, Controls) that loads and saves user settings via React Query hooks, with toggles and selects for various options.
frontend/src/components/three/AnimalMana: Manages spawning and AI behavior (idle, roaming, fleeing, attacking) for various animal types in the 3D world, rendering each as a simple box-mesh character updated per frame.
frontend/src/components/three/BiomeZones: Defines and renders the 3D world's biome zones including city buildings, houses, trees, and roads using React Three Fiber primitives and @react-three/drei Text labels.
frontend/src/components/three/NPCManager: Spawns and updates NPC characters with roles (civilian, police, dealer, etc.) across the world, handling movement states and rendering capsule-based meshes with hover name labels.
frontend/src/components/three/PlayerCont: A React Three Fiber component that handles first/third-person player movement, keyboard input, mouse look with pointer lock, gravity, jumping, and sprinting/flight modes.
frontend/src/components/three/Terrain.ts: Generates and renders a 3D terrain mesh with procedural heightmap including mountains, city flatlands, hills, and a river valley, plus water and snow overlay planes.
frontend/src/components/three/VehicleMan: Manages and renders a set of parked vehicles (cars, trucks, helicopters, planes, boats) with type-specific meshes, hover labels, and click-to-enter interaction.
frontend/src/components/three/World.tsx: Composes the full 3D world scene including sky, stars, fog, dynamic sun lighting, terrain, biome zones, NPCs, animals, and vehicles.
frontend/src/components/WantedLevelIndic: Displays a HUD element showing the player's wanted level as 0–5 highlighted stars; renders nothing when level is 0.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlayerInput.ts: A hook that tracks keyboard input state for player movement and one-shot actions (interact, inventory, map, etc.) via refs, with enable/disable support.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlayerStats.ts: React hook managing player stats (health, hunger, thirst, armor) with automatic decay over time and actions for eating, drinking, taking damage, healing, and adding armor.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks wrapping backend actor calls for user profile, settings, job, home, and friend/social operations with cache invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useWantedLevel.ts: React hook tracking a 0–5 wanted level that automatically decays over time, with functions to increment or clear it.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file importing Orbitron and Exo 2 fonts, configuring Tailwind with OKLCH-based design tokens, and defining custom utility classes for neon glows, glass panels, and game-themed UI elements.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/GameView.tsx: Main game page rendering a Three.js canvas with player controller, HUD, chat, inventory, job board, and pause menu, wiring together player stats, wanted level, settings, and keyboard controls.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page displaying a hero banner, game stats, and feature highlights for Maplewood Canada with a play button that triggers the onPlay callback.
frontend/src/utils/npcAI.ts: Utility module defining NPC types, data structures, and AI logic including NPC creation, random dialogue selection, state transitions based on player proximity and wanted level, and waypoint generation.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a dark gaming theme with custom fonts (Orbitron, Exo 2), neon color palette using OKLCH, custom shadows, and keyframe animations like glow-pulse and slide-in-up.
project_state.json: Project state manifest describing a Roblox-style TRXGAMING homepage with a single open-world game (Maplewood, Canada), tracking existing features, architectural notes, image requirements, and known issues.
